group:paper-gaokao-2023-i:reading-c.overview: 这是一本讲“数字极简主义”的书的前言节选。作者说明本书旨在倡导这一理念，并介绍全书结构：第一部分讲哲学基础、“数字清理”方法和实验案例，第二部分讲培养这种生活方式的理念和实践。
group:paper-gaokao-2023-i:reading-c.fullTranslationZh:
本书的目标是为数字极简主义提出论证，包括详细探讨它要求什么、为什么有效，然后在你认定它适合你的情况下，教你如何践行这一理念。
为此，我把全书分为两部分。在第一部分，我阐述数字极简主义的哲学基础：先考察那些让许多人的数字生活越来越难以忍受的力量，再详细讨论数字极简主义这一理念。
第一部分的结尾介绍我建议的践行这一理念的方法：数字清理。这一过程要求你在三十天里远离可有可无的网络活动。三十天结束时，你再重新加入少量精心挑选的、你认为会给你所珍视的事物带来巨大益处的网络活动。
在第一部分的最后一章，我将指导你完成自己的数字清理。在此过程中，我会借用我在2018年做的一项实验，当时有1600多人同意进行数字清理。你会听到这些参与者的故事，了解哪些策略对他们很有效，以及他们遇到了哪些你应当避开的陷阱。
本书第二部分会更深入地探讨一些有助于你培养可持续的数字极简生活方式的理念。在这些章节中，我探讨了诸如独处的重要性，以及培养高质量休闲活动、用来取代如今大多数人花在无意识使用设备上的时间的必要性等问题。每章结尾都附有一组实践方法，旨在帮助你把本章的重要理念付诸行动。你可以把这些实践方法看作一个工具箱，用来帮助你努力打造适合自身具体情况的极简生活方式。

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities that you believe will provide massive benefits to the things you value.
selectedLongSentences.displayText: At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities that you believe will provide massive benefits to the things you value.
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 三十天结束时，你再重新加入少量精心挑选的、你认为会给你所珍视的事物带来巨大益处的网络活动。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 you will then add back … online activities（你再加回网络活动），句首 At the end of the thirty days 是时间状语。a small number of carefully chosen 修饰 online activities，强调“少量、精选”。that 引导定语从句修饰 activities，从句里 you believe 是插入成分，真正的结构是 that will provide massive benefits to …；末尾 the things you value 又是省略 that 的定语从句。add back 说明是先清空、再加回，正好帮助理解 declutter。

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
selectedLongSentences.displayText: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 在第一部分，我阐述数字极简主义的哲学基础：先考察那些让许多人的数字生活越来越难以忍受的力量，再详细讨论数字极简主义这一理念。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 I describe the philosophical foundations（我阐述哲学基础）。后面 starting with … 是现在分词短语作伴随状语，说明从哪里讲起；其中 that are making … increasingly intolerable 是定语从句修饰 the forces，make + 宾语 + 形容词表示“使……变得难以忍受”。before moving on to … 再交代接下来讲什么。starting with 和 before moving on to 一前一后，把第一部分的讲述顺序串了起来。

question:paper-gaokao-2023-i:28.questionFocus: 找到作者直接交代本书目标的句子，并认出“数字极简主义”在选项里的对应说法。

trap.relationNote: Teaching 和原文的 teach（教）同根，但书要教的是怎样践行数字极简主义（how to adopt this philosophy），不是批判性思维技能。

trapEvidence.quote: to teach you how to adopt this philosophy

optionAnalysis.label: B

evidence.quote: The goal of this book is to make the case for digital minimalism, including a detailed exploration of what it asks and why it works, and then to teach you how to adopt this philosophy if you decide it’s right for you.

trap.relationNote: philosophical 出自 [[block:paper-gaokao-2023-i:reading-c:2|I describe the philosophical foundations]]，指第一部分先讲这一理念的哲学基础（philosophical foundations），书的目标并不是解决哲学问题。

trapEvidence.quote: I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism

question:paper-gaokao-2023-i:29.questionFocus: 根据后文对这一方法步骤的解释，推断画线词 declutter 的意思。
question:paper-gaokao-2023-i:29.stemTranslationZh: 第3段中画线词“declutter”是什么意思？
question:paper-gaokao-2023-i:29.locateFindZh: 往后找这个方法具体要你做什么

evidence.quote: This process requires you to step away from optional online activities for thirty days.
At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities that you believe will provide massive benefits to the things you value.

trap.relationNote: Add 借自 [[block:paper-gaokao-2023-i:reading-c:3|you will then add back]]，可那是三十天后才加回少量活动；放进去，这个方法就成了“数字附加”，和它先要人远离网络活动相反。

trapEvidence.quote: you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities

trap.explanation: 放进去成了“数字登记”，可后文讲的是远离网络活动、再精选少量加回，没有任何登记、报到的意思。

trap.sourceQuote: This process requires you to step away from optional online activities for thirty days.
trap.explanation: 放进去成了“数字接管”，像是让网络占据生活，而这个方法恰恰要人远离网络活动（step away from）。

trapEvidence.quote: This process requires you to step away from optional online activities for thirty days.

locationParaphrases.targetText: Part one concludes by introducing my suggested method for adopting this philosophy: the digital declutter.
locationParaphrases.answerText: step away from optional online activities for thirty days
locationParaphrases.bridgeZh: This process 指数字清理，这句说出它要做的事
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 declutter 原词出现在原文。

locationParaphrases.targetText: step away from optional online activities
locationParaphrases.note: 后文说这个方法要你三十天远离可有可无的网络活动（step away from），之后只加回少量精选的活动（add back a small number），所以“declutter”必须是“先清掉、再精挑”的意思。放回去：践行理念的方法就是“数字清理”，正是 Clear-up（清理），选 A。

trap.sourceQuote: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism
trap.explanation: 偏理论的内容是 [[block:paper-gaokao-2023-i:reading-c:2]] 说的第一部分前面讲的哲学基础（philosophical foundations）；最后一章转向带读者动手做清理，也没有提出什么模型。

trapEvidence.quote: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism

evidence.quote: In doing so, I’ll draw on an experiment I ran in 2018 in which over 1,600 people agreed to perform a digital declutter.
You’ll hear these participants’ stories and learn what strategies worked well for them, and what traps they encountered that you should avoid.

trap.explanation: 2018 年的实验是作者自己近年做的，用来提供参与者的经验；这一章没有回顾、分析历史。

locationParaphrases.targetText: In the final chapter of part one, I’ll guide you through carrying out your own digital declutter.
locationParaphrases.answerText: draw on an experiment I ran in 2018 in which over 1,600 people agreed to perform a digital declutter
locationParaphrases.bridgeZh: In doing so 指带你完成数字清理的过程
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 final chapter of part one 原词出现在原文。

locationParaphrases.targetText: You’ll hear these participants’ stories and learn what strategies worked well for them, and what traps they encountered that you should avoid.
locationParaphrases.note: 原文没用“例子”一词，要把两处合起来看：作者指导时借用自己2018年的实验（an experiment），[[block:paper-gaokao-2023-i:reading-c:4|You’ll hear these participants’ stories]] 又说读者会听到参与者的故事（participants’ stories）、学到哪些策略管用。这些真人真事的做法就是“实践实例”，选 C。

evidence.quote: You can view these practices as a toolbox meant to aid your efforts to build a minimalist lifestyle that works for your particular circumstances.

trapEvidence.quote: which are designed to help you act on the big ideas of the chapter

locationParaphrases.note: 题干 practices 原词出现在原文。

locationParaphrases.targetText: You can view these practices as a toolbox meant to aid your efforts to build a minimalist lifestyle that works for your particular circumstances.
locationParaphrases.note: 作者建议把这些方法看作一个工具箱（a toolbox），工具箱里的东西是用到哪样拿哪样；他又说要适合你的具体情况（your particular circumstances），可见是让读者按自己的需要选用，选 A。
